name: Akmal Ariq
title: Data Analytics & AI Engineer
bio: I'm a Data Analytics & AI Engineer based in Jakarta with 4 years across banking and retail, building data platforms end to end: profiling, data modeling, quality assurance, and reporting. I'm currently at Kanmo Group building a modern lakehouse for multiple retail brands, and applying LLMs and retrieval-augmented generation to data quality and analytics. I'm a DataTalks.Club Data Engineering Zoomcamp graduate (2026).

highlights: Building a modern lakehouse (S3-compatible object storage, ClickHouse, dbt, Dagster) for multiple retail brands.
Ingesting POS, marketplaces, ads, and accounting data into one reliable source of truth.
Applying LLMs, RAG, and agentic workflows to data quality checks and analytics.
Owned production ingestion and transformation pipelines across retail brands.
Introduced dbt modeling and Dagster orchestration with data-quality checks.
Led a zero-downtime migration of 20+ production pipelines.
Cut a key regulatory report's runtime by 83% while keeping 100% accuracy on OJK and Bank Indonesia submissions.
Worked with regulated data: PII handling, maker-checker controls, and audit trails.
Built a cloud-native Earthquake Analytics capstone pipeline using GCP, BigQuery, Kestra, dbt, and Looker Studio.
Covered workflow orchestration, dbt transformations, partitioned and clustered warehousing, and Infrastructure as Code.
